column1: # The release's pins (TVI-WO-1200), tab-separated, one home for each. Read by tools/tviburi-release, which
# names every row in the MANIFEST it writes.
#   build  <assembly> <build string>   the consumer's pinned Renode (RUL-09), read from the image's assemblies
#                                      (TVI-WO-0100b FEEDBACK §2 item 5); Tviburi's runner checks the first
#   stock  <sha256> <path>             the stm32h753.repl include chain, in include order, as Aethelgard pins it
#   class  <stock type> <guard type> <instances>   the class map (RUL-09): one row per guard, never two; the fourth
#                                      column names the instances the guard takes over, one space between (TVI-WO-1303
#                                      Q9 (c); required since TVI-WO-1203). One the pinned stock chain declares is
#                                      `restate`d in the MANIFEST, and the release refuses it unless a committed
#                                      model/stm32h7-*-restate.repl runs it under the guard; one it does not declare is
#                                      the consumer's own, `retype`d (SPI's spi1, spi2: the consumer's committed fixture
#                                      declares them and every replay re-types them; tests/spike.sh manifest)
